sections.heading: What is Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL)?
paragraphs: A Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) procedure is a popular body contouring technique that enhances the shape and volume of the buttocks using your body’s own natural fat. This body contouring procedure combines liposuction and fat transfer to create fuller curves, improve body proportions, and achieve a more sculpted, feminine silhouette.

During a BBL procedure, unwanted fat is extracted from areas such as the abdomen, waistline, flanks, back, or thighs through liposuction. The purified fat is then strategically transferred to the buttocks to enhance volume, shape, and contour while ensuring natural-looking results.

At Tampa Bay Body Sculpting, we collaborate with a carefully selected network of Board-Certified Cosmetic Surgeons in Florida who are experienced in advanced body contouring and BBL procedures. Each treatment plan is customized based on your body type, desired shape, and aesthetic goals. This popular procedure is designed to enhance waist definition, eliminate stubborn fat that resists diet and exercise, and create a slimmer, more contoured silhouette. Lipo 360 is often combined with other procedures such as a Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL), Tummy Tuck, or Abdominal Sculpting to further enhance overall body proportions and definition.

A Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) is a body contouring procedure that uses your own fat to enhance the shape, volume, and projection of the buttocks. Fat is removed from areas such as the abdomen, waist, flanks, or back through liposuction, purified, and strategically transferred to the buttocks to create fuller, natural-looking results.

Healthy patients looking to enhance the size and shape of their buttocks while contouring other areas of the body may be good candidates for a BBL. Candidates should have enough excess fat available for transfer and be close to their target weight.

A Brazilian Butt Lift typically includes liposuction to contour one or more of the following areas: the abdomen, waist, flanks (love handles), and lower back, or Lipo 360. The purified fat is then transferred to the buttocks to improve volume, projection, and overall shape.

Ultrasound-guided BBL technology allows the provider to visualize the cannula during fat transfer in real time, helping ensure fat is placed in the appropriate tissue plane. This advanced technique enhances precision and supports current safety recommendations for Brazilian Butt Lift surgery.
A Brazilian Butt Lift can enhance buttock shape and projection, improve body proportions, create an hourglass silhouette, and provide natural-looking results.

Swelling, bruising, and soreness are common during the initial recovery period. Patients are typically advised to avoid direct pressure on the buttocks for several weeks to help protect the transferred fat and optimize results.

sections.heading: Lipo360 + Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) Recovery Guide
First 24 Hours After Lipo360 + BBL
paragraphs: After your BBL procedure, it's essential to rest and avoid strenuous activity. Take short walks around your home as directed to promote healing, and stay hydrated. Be sure to take medications as prescribed to aid in recovery. Additionally, avoid direct pressure on the buttocks to ensure optimal results from your body contouring.

sections.heading: First 24 Hours After Lipo360 + BBL
paragraphs: Continue wearing compression garments as directed after your BBL procedure. Avoid sitting directly on the buttocks to ensure optimal healing. Sleep on your stomach or side if recommended by your provider following your body contouring. Walk frequently throughout the day to promote circulation. Maintain a healthy, protein-rich diet to support recovery. Stay hydrated to aid in the healing process.

sections.heading: Weeks 2–4
paragraphs: Improved comfort and mobility are key benefits of the BBL procedure, along with reduced bruising and decreased swelling. This body contouring technique also enhances visible waistline definition and improves buttock shape.

sections.heading: Weeks 2–4
paragraphs: Swelling continues to decrease following the BBL procedure, allowing body contours to become more visible. As recovery progresses, energy levels improve, and physical activity may gradually increase. Overall, results from the body contouring process continue to develop.

sections.heading: Recovery Tips
paragraphs: With the BBL procedure, you can achieve improved body proportions, greater clothing confidence, and more defined curves. This body contouring technique offers long-lasting contour improvements, and the final results continue to mature over several months.

sections.heading: Recovery Tips
paragraphs: After undergoing a BBL procedure, it's essential to avoid direct pressure on the buttocks to ensure optimal healing. Wearing compression garments can aid in the recovery process, while staying hydrated is crucial for overall health. It's also important to focus on protein-rich nutrition to support body contouring and muscle repair. Remember to walk frequently, as gentle movement can promote circulation. Lastly, always follow your provider's instructions for the best results.
